rows.label: tlk41200126_01_msg0001
rows.name: Do you know what a Torigoriuto is?

rows.label: tlk41200126_01_msg0002
rows.name:
It's the instrument I'm
playing right now.

rows.label: tlk41200126_01_msg0003
rows.name:
I practice as hard as I can every
night, but I still have a long way
to go.

rows.label: tlk41200126_01_msg0004
rows.name:
All Gulans love music, you see.
No one will acknowledge you unless
you get really, really good.
